newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 25.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 25.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- German President Roman Herzog began its three-day official visit to Budapest.
- The spokesman of Hungary's Foreign Ministry said that the White House called suggestions that Hungary may be excluded from the first wave of NATO-enlargement unfounded and nonsensical.
- Both the government and agricultural producers blocking several main roads in the country in protest against new tax regulations are ready for compromise.
- Hungary and Romania on Tuesday signed an agreement which opens the way to set up consulates in Cluj, Romania and Szeged, Hungary.
- Hungary's army cannot expect considerable technical development until next year, military experts said.
- The parliament began the discussion of the law which would open the way for the establishment of mortgage loan companies.
